To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have demonstrated the first wideband SIC technique that is integrated in the RF domain, which enables FDD and FD wireless applications.
a fully integrated technique for multiband wideband SI cancellation in the RF domain has been proposed and implemented for FDD and FD wireless.

1) the proposed RF domain wideband SIC can achieve >20 MHz BW for FDD and FD wireless, 2) the RF domain SIC enhances RX IIP3 and/or IIP2 by up to 29 and 58 dB, respectively, and 3) RF domain SIC enables FD wireless operation with 1 dB gain compression at -8 dBm IB SI
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of a novel wideband SIC circuit in the RF domain that can be used in both FDD and FD wireless applications.
the problem of interference cancellation for full duplex radios.
the design and analysis of integrated circuits (ICs) for wideband self-interference cancellation (SIC).
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the integrated wideband SIC technique proposed in this work enables multiband FDD and FD wireless systems to operate in the presence of high OOB and IB SI, respectively.
a wideband RF SIC technique that is integrated with the RX front-end and is capable of achieving wideband SIC for both FDD and FD wireless applications is presented.

a fully integrated wideband RF domain SIC technique for multiband FDD and FD wireless is proposed and implemented in CMOS, and it is shown that this RF SIC technique enables effective OOB and IB cancellation, and enhances the IIP3 and IP2 performance of the receiver.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed technique is a practical and effective way to implement wideband SIC for FDD and FD wireless.

the proposed wideband RF SIC technique is the first to achieve wideband cancellation across a wide range of frequency-selective antenna isolation characteristics, and it is the first to demonstrate the feasibility of FD wireless with high-performance IB and OOB SI cancellation.

the proposed wideband RF SIC technique is the first integrated technique for multiband FDD and FD wireless applications, which achieves wideband SI cancellation across frequency-selective and frequency-selective antenna interface.
The main takeaway from our work is that
wideband SIC can be implemented with high BW, high linearity, and high dynamic range, and can enable the use of FDD and FD wireless for applications where OOB SI and/or high IB SI is present.
integrated wideband RF SIC is feasible and effective for multiband FDD and FD wireless.

the proposed RF domain SI canceller can be used to enhance the performance of multiband FDD and FD wireless applications by providing a wideband, frequency-selective cancellation of SI in the RF domain.
